expectations.text: Places the supplier in Category B (6 to 249 employees or SAR 3M to 200M revenue) under NCNICC-1:2025
expectations.evidence: "falls under NCA NCNICC-1:2025 as a Category B SME" ... "Category B covers 6 to 249 employees or SAR 3M to 200M revenue. 40 employees fits"

expectations.text: States Category B faces 13 sub-components and 26 mandatory controls, with the remainder recommended
expectations.evidence: "Category B has 13 sub-components and 26 mandatory controls. The remaining controls are recommended, not required."

expectations.text: Notes the instrument was published in Arabic only
expectations.evidence: "It was adopted on 28 December 2025 and is published in Arabic only."

expectations.text: States compliance is continuous with no published deadline
expectations.evidence: "No compliance deadline has been published, and the NCA may assess at any time without notice. The supplier should treat readiness as immediate."

expectations.text: Distinguishes NCNICC applicability from the ECC, which targets critical national infrastructure
expectations.evidence: NCNICC listed as "Mandatory, Category B SME" while "ECC-2:2024 is not mandatory for them" because the supplier "does not own, operate or host CNI."
